keyFindings.description: A SIGKILLed step leaves its runner_wait (the rc=$(runner_wait ...) command substitution, cluster.sh:2347) polling; it has no liveness or lock check, and at the step's deadline (up to 30+window+20+900 s) runner_stop sends TERM to /work/logs/<job>.pid in whatever pod is named runner in the namespace. A later run with the same step name gets its job killed and records loadgen_exit. The README's killed-step section says down ends what is left, but down touches no local process. cluster.test.sh's own cleanup pkills this orphan.

The heap.txt note says the file stays in the runner even when it is the existence check (2294-2295) that failed; and README.md:1999 puts the note inside the step-failed.json row though it goes only to the command's output.
runner_copy_back's 0/1/2 return protocol is decoded by a case in run_in_runner; have runner_copy_back do its own runner cleanup and heap note and return 0/1.
The failed-kinds descriptions are copied word for word in cgrouptables.go:64 and curves.go:816, the copy that drifted in round 2; keep one constant.
